details: Project on the largest shattered set. The reverse inequality is false in general. The reverse bound $\mathrm d_{\min}^p\le\mathrm{dens}^p\le2\mathrm{VC}$ follows from relationships 64 and 62. Hence the strict separation cannot become an unbounded ratio.
proof: If $S$ is shattered with $|S|=d$, the projection to $S$ is the full $d$-cube and has minimum degree $d$. Hence projected minimum degree is at least VC dimension. Equality cannot be asserted in general: there are classes with VC dimension $10$ and minimum degree $11$, and the full projection is one candidate in the projected maximum.
witness_verification: For every d at least 10, Corollary 44 gives VC(V_d)=d and ordinary minimum degree d+1; projected minimum degree is at least the ordinary one by the full projection.
name: Projected Minimum Degree / VC Dimension
